note: Read 2026-11-03. Majority: the Age of Majority Act 1971 (Act 21), s. 2, in the Commissioner of Law Revision's reprint incorporating amendments to 1 January 2006: the minority of all males and females ends at eighteen. Work: null. The Children and Young Persons (Employment) Act 1966 (Act 350) was read only in its 2006 reprint ('child' under fourteen, 'young person' under sixteen; s. 7, a licence from the Director General of Labour for a child or young person in public entertainment); whether later amendments changed those ages wasn't read (the Act's page on lom.agc.gov.my answered 'Invalid request'), so the working age isn't held. Service: null; the 2026 national service (PLKN 3.0) was read only in press reports quoting its department, not in the Act.

sources.title: Laws of Malaysia, Act 21, Age of Majority Act 1971 (reprint incorporating all amendments up to 1 January 2006), Commissioner of Law Revision
sources.said: 2. Subject to section 4, the minority of all males and females shall cease and determine within Malaysia at the age of eighteen years and every such male and female attaining that age shall be of the age of majority.
